title: Drop-In Tech Time with Oliver
description: 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM · Drop by the 2nd floor desk for Tech Time with Oliver every Sunday from 1-3pm. Bring your questions about technology (phones, tablets, laptops, email, etc.) or learn about special collections the library offers, such as the Kindles, iPads, and laptops our patrons can check out as well as the library apps you can download to your devices to access free ebooks, audiobooks, movies, music, magazines and more! Pásate por el 2º piso para Tech Time con Oliver (habla español) todos los domingos de 1 a 3pm. Traiga sus preguntas sobre tecnología (teléfonos, tabletas, computadoras portátiles, correo electrónico, etc.) o conozca las colecciones especiales que ofrece la biblioteca, como los Kindles, iPads y computadoras portátiles que nuestros usuarios pueden rentar, así como las aplicaciones de la biblioteca que puede descargar en sus dispositivos para acceder a libros electrónicos, audiolibros, películas, música, revistas y más.

title: Tea and Tarot
description: 2:30 PM – 4:30 PM · Tea and Tarot Sessions with Jade Rose and others from Sanctuary Collective Seating is limited; please sign up here in advance.   Tea Ceremony is a perfect elemental art. Silently, we drink tea from ancient trees grown in reverence. In this special space we give the water, fire and tea leaves a chance to communicate with us in their subtle and silent tongue. Old growth trees have been taking in sunlight, rainwater and starlight for hundreds of years. Drinking tea from their leaves in a ceremonial space allows us access parts of our heart which we usually cannot reach.

title: The Real Book Club: Jazz Standards
description: 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM · Join us for The Real Book Club, a monthly jazz jam session for musicians of all levels who want to dive into classic jazz standards together! Whether you're a seasoned improviser or just starting out, this is a welcoming space to play, practice, and connect with fellow jazz enthusiasts. Each month, we'll focus on three jazz standards selected from The Real Book. You'll receive PDFs of the tunes in advance so you can shed at home and come ready to jam. Lead sheets will also be available on the day of the event. The songs we will play at this jam are: Once I Loved by Antonio Carlos Jobim. Here is a version I quite like with Astrud Gilberto singing. title: Around The World- Portugal
description: 5:30 PM – 6:30 PM · Have you been to Portugal? Join us at The Wine Mine for a journey to Portugal. We will explore the history, regions and do some taste testing along the way.  Must be 21years old to attend.
